# A customer stating the guid of the NASDAQ:AMZN price in
# prices_of_a_currency_and_a_stock.txt.
#
# GnuCash keeps a guid unique across every kind of object in a book, and a
# price is one of them.
#
# What this fixture produces: nothing; the customer is refused, and the refusal
# says a price holds that guid.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_price_and_another_object_never_share_a_guid.py.
customer "C-PRICE-GUID"
  guid: "4a1a4c0c7328491fbde9f8099ba280c8"
  name: "A Customer Stating A Price's Guid"
  currency: CAD
